answer: Histories are stored in marble, checked in inlet, and wander makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3580 identities would post 3506 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
